The '''Breath Stealing''' was an event that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alphoresis]] [[2132 BBY|eleven centuries before]] [[Operation Influx]], when a [[plague]] resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of every child on the world under the age of eight.
